identitySignals: Name matches 'Rising Star Sped Academy', a California nonpublic school/agency providing special education services (rssped.com; CDE School Directory lists it, but the CDE page could not be fetched)
Website describes special education, ABA and therapy services, matching OUSD's special education Nonpublic School/Agency master contract

Agenda gives Milpitas, CA, but the organization's own site lists only a Fremont, CA administrative office and no Milpitas campus; a Milpitas address (1551 McCarthy Blvd) appeared only in a search-result snippet from a business directory, not confirmed
research.notes: Not publishable: no registry (CA Secretary of State, SAM.gov, IRS) was confirmed, so legal name, entity numbers and org type are unverified (orgType 'other' is a placeholder). Agenda location (Milpitas) does not match the organization's website (admin office in Fremont; campuses in San Jose, Hayward, Dublin, Vallejo, Yuba City). A third-party directory snippet gave Milpitas address 1551 McCarthy Blvd Ste 204 but this was not verified. CDE School Directory page was bot-blocked. No phone number is published on the site.

profile.summary: Rising Star Sped Academy provides special education and related services for students with diverse learning needs. Its website describes personalized learning, Applied Behavior Analysis (ABA), speech therapy, occupational therapy and behavioral support, delivered at campuses in several California counties.
